title: Linear mediation path diagram
content: Figure 9.7 has a direct Treatment-to-Outcome effect of 7 and an indirect Treatment-to-Mediator-to-Outcome effect with coefficients 2 and 3. The sum-of-products rule gives indirect effect 6 and total effect 13.

variables.name: Treatment
variables.content: The treatment increased by one unit.

variables.name: Mediator
variables.content: The mediator increases by two units for a unit treatment increase.

variables.name: Outcome
variables.content: The outcome receives both direct and mediated effects.

arrows.because: Figure 9.7 labels the Treatment-to-Mediator path coefficient 2.
Figure 9.7 labels the Mediator-to-Outcome path coefficient 3.
Figure 9.7 labels the direct Treatment-to-Outcome path coefficient 7.
